articles.title: The future of crypto payments won't include on-ramps or bridges, Fun CEO says
articles.snippet: Alex Fine said standalone crypto payment rails are becoming obsolete as platforms shift toward unified funding flows that abstract away blockchain complexity for users.

articles.title: Quantum computing nears commercial breakthrough, IBM CEO says
articles.snippet: Arvind Krishna said quantum computing will begin generating meaningful revenue before the decade ends as investment in the sector accelerates, in an interview on CNBC.

articles.title: BNB Chain pursues legal action after ex-employee’s memecoin launch
articles.snippet: BNB Chain said a former employee allegedly used a company tutorial wallet to create a memecoin that the blockchain ecosystem says it did not authorize or endorse.

articles.title: Trump Media sells another 2,628 BTC, holdings fall to 4,261 BTC
articles.snippet: Trump Media transferred another 2,628 Bitcoin to Crypto.com, bringing its reported sales over seven months to 7,281 BTC and leaving the company with 4,261 BTC in holdings.

articles.title: Pump.fun laid off workers before they received millions in PUMP tokens: Report
articles.snippet: Pump.fun co-founder Noah Tweedale reportedly attributed the layoffs to the company growing too quickly.
